Question Choices: Find the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of 8 and 24.
Hints: List common positive factors; choose the greatest one.
Solution: Factors of 8: 1, 2, 4, 8; Factors of 24: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24. Common factors: 1, 2, 4, 8. The greatest is 8.

Question Choices: You have 20 apples and 30 oranges. You want to make identical groups, each with the same number of apples and the same number of oranges, with no leftovers. What is the largest number of groups you can make?
Hints: List common positive factors; choose the greatest one.
Solution: Factors of 20: 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 20; Factors of 30: 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 10, 15, 30. Common factors: 1, 2, 5, 10. The greatest is 10. Make 10 identical groups, each with 2 of the first item and 3 of the second item. Check: 10×2=20 and 10×3=30.
